content.title: Two-Layer Semantic Performance | Live Anchor, Graphic Response, Final Line
content.summary: A radio host drives SIGNAL, REACH and LISTEN graphics into a STAY TUNED split-screen lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One live performer remains registered in a stable band. + Each exact keyword follows one readable performance cue. + The graphic band produces one distinct response per cue. + Typography never obscures the identity anchor. + Both bands resolve on one final performer-and-line state.
quick_start.recommended_input: Keep one adult radio host in the upper band and an abstract paper-wave field in the lower band. A small hand wave activates the exact word REACH and extends one ink line across the lower field. Resolve both bands on the host's still gaze and the exact final line STAY TUNED.
required_anchors: One live performer remains registered in a stable band.
Each exact keyword follows one readable performance cue.
Typography never obscures the identity anchor.
Both bands resolve on one final performer-and-line state.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A radio host drives SIGNAL, REACH and LISTEN graphics into a STAY TUNED split-screen lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
